name: ADX / DI trend
idea: A signal when the directional lines show one side leading while ADX is above its threshold and rising; the idea has ended on the opposite directional cross, or when ADX falls back below the threshold.

params.label: ADX period
params.help: Bars behind ADX and the directional lines.

params.label: ADX threshold
params.help: ADX must be above this level.

params.label: ADX rising over (bars)
params.help: ADX must be higher than it was this many bars before.

params.label: The signal comes when
params.help: The event that gives the signal: the directional lines cross (with ADX above its threshold and rising), or ADX rises through its threshold (with the leading line on the same side).

params.label: The idea has ended when
params.help: The opposite directional cross, or ADX falling back below its threshold.

params.label: Swing size
params.help: Which swings count: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history.

di_cross.long: CrossAbove(PlusDI($adx_period), MinusDI($adx_period)) AND ADX($adx_period) > $adx_threshold AND ADX($adx_period) > Lag(ADX($adx_period), $rise_bars)
di_cross.short: CrossAbove(MinusDI($adx_period), PlusDI($adx_period)) AND ADX($adx_period) > $adx_threshold AND ADX($adx_period) > Lag(ADX($adx_period), $rise_bars)

adx_threshold.long: CrossAbove(ADX($adx_period), $adx_threshold) AND PlusDI($adx_period) > MinusDI($adx_period) AND ADX($adx_period) > Lag(ADX($adx_period), $rise_bars)
adx_threshold.short: CrossAbove(ADX($adx_period), $adx_threshold) AND MinusDI($adx_period) > PlusDI($adx_period) AND ADX($adx_period) > Lag(ADX($adx_period), $rise_bars)
